name: BMS
recent: BMS Holdings 于2026年11月23日公布2027财年第一季度业绩，营收同比增长8.53%至RM92.05百万，但净利同比下滑5.40%。公司于10月27日宣布通过RM5百万合资企业进军北马市场，同时于10月22日终止了RM23.8百万的Cheras房产收购。此外，公司于11月23日召开第二届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 公司通过RM5百万合资企业进军北马市场。

risks: 首席运营官Lee Kong Siong于11月12日因传输取得23,818,776股（1.547%）。

earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为RM89.59百万，净利RM5.04百万，净利率5.6%；营收环比增长3.0%，净利环比增长119.1%，净利率较上期的2.6%有所提升。

recent_en: BMS Holdings announced its 1Q FY2027 results on 23 November 2026, with revenue up 8.53% year-on-year to RM92.05 million but net profit down 5.40%. The company announced a RM5 million joint venture to expand into Northern Malaysia on 27 October, and terminated a RM23.8 million Cheras property acquisition on 22 October. The company also held its 2nd AGM on 23 November, with all resolutions passed.
notable_en: The company formed a RM5 million joint venture to expand into Northern Malaysia.
The company terminated the RM23.8 million Cheras property acquisition, with the earnest deposit refunded.
The company reported 1Q FY2027 results with revenue up 8.53% year-on-year to RM92.05 million and net profit down 5.40%.
risks_en: Chief Operating Officer Lee Kong Siong acquired 23,818,776 shares (1.547%) via transmission on 12 November.
Executive Director Lee Kok Chuan indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
The company terminated the property acquisition as parties could not reach a final agreement on the SPA terms.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM89.59 million with net profit of RM5.04 million and net margin of 5.6%; revenue grew 3.0% QoQ, net profit rose 119.1% QoQ, and net margin improved from 2.6% in the prior period.
